# Terms of Use

> **DRAFT — NOT LEGAL ADVICE.** Not reviewed by a lawyer. The liability and
> refund positions in particular may be unenforceable in some jurisdictions —
> see `docs/legal/README.md`.

**Version:** `2026-07-26.1`

These terms govern your use of WarmReach Pro. By creating an account you agree
to them, to the [Acceptable Use Policy](ACCEPTABLE_USE.md), and to the
[Privacy Policy](PRIVACY_POLICY.md). Before using automation features you must
also acknowledge the
[LinkedIn Automation Risk Disclosure](LINKEDIN_RISK_DISCLOSURE.md).

## 1. What the service is

WarmReach is software that helps you manage professional relationships. It has
two parts: a web application, and a desktop client you install that automates
actions on LinkedIn using your own account, from your own machine.

We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to LinkedIn Corporation.

## 2. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 and able to enter a contract. You must use your own
LinkedIn account, or have documented authority to operate the account you use.

## 3. The LinkedIn risk is yours

**This is the term most likely to matter to you, so it is stated plainly.**

LinkedIn's User Agreement restricts automated access to its service, and
LinkedIn restricts, suspends and permanently bans accounts it believes are
automated. Using WarmReach's automation features may therefore cost you your
LinkedIn account.

You accept that risk. We are not liable for any loss arising from LinkedIn
restricting or terminating your account, including loss of connections, message
history, business opportunities, income or reputation.

**We do not refund subscription fees because your LinkedIn account was
restricted or banned.** If you are not prepared to accept that, do not use the
automation features.

Full detail is in the [Risk Disclosure](LINKEDIN_RISK_DISCLOSURE.md), which you
must acknowledge before automation is enabled.

## 4. Your account

You are responsible for your credentials and for activity under your account.
Tell us promptly if you believe it has been compromised.

Your LinkedIn credentials are stored on your own device, encrypted using your
operating system's keychain. We never receive them, and consequently we cannot
recover them for you.

## 5. Subscriptions and billing

Paid plans are billed monthly in advance through Stripe and renew automatically
until cancelled. Cancelling stops the next renewal; access continues to the end
of the period you have paid for.

Fees are non-refundable except where required by law, or at our discretion. We
may change pricing with at least 30 days' notice before it affects you.

Plans include monthly allowances of AI operations and LinkedIn actions. Exceeding
an allowance stops further operations until the period resets; it does not incur
an automatic charge.

## 6. Acceptable use

The [Acceptable Use Policy](ACCEPTABLE_USE.md) is part of these terms. Breaching
it may result in suspension or termination without refund.

## 7. Your data and your connections' data

You keep ownership of your content. You grant us the licence needed to operate
the service for you — storing it, processing it, and sending it to the
sub-processors listed in the Privacy Policy.

**You are responsible for your relationship with the people in your network.**
Where the law makes you a controller of their data, its obligations are yours.
We provide export and deletion so you can comply; we do not comply on your
behalf.

## 8. AI output

AI-generated messages, analysis and research may be wrong, misleading or
inappropriate. **Read anything before you send it.** You are responsible for
everything sent from your account, whether you wrote it or the model did.

Scores and rankings are estimates, not facts about people.

## 9. Availability

We aim for high availability and do not promise it. The service depends on third
parties — AWS, OpenAI, Stripe, and LinkedIn itself — and may be interrupted by
their outages or changes. LinkedIn may change its site at any time in ways that
break automation, and we do not guarantee that we will restore it.

## 10. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent the law allows:

- The service is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind.
- We are not liable for indirect, incidental, special or consequential loss, or
  for lost profits, revenue, data or goodwill.
- Our total liability for any claim is limited to the fees you paid in the three
  months before the claim arose.
- We are specifically not liable for anything arising from LinkedIn's treatment
  of your account.

Nothing here excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded — including
liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, or for fraud. Some
jurisdictions do not permit some of these exclusions, in which case they apply
to you only so far as the law allows.

## 11. Termination

You may stop and delete your account at any time in the app.

We may suspend or terminate your account for breach of these terms or the
Acceptable Use Policy, if required by law, or if continuing to provide the
service becomes impractical. Where we terminate without cause we refund the
unused portion of your current period.

## 12. Changes

We will bump the version on these terms and ask you to re-accept when the
substance changes. Continuing to use the service after that is acceptance.
